sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH units_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.department_code,
        d.department_name,
        AVG(s.total_units) AS avg_total_units,
        VARIANCE(s.total_units) AS variance_total_units,
        STDDEV(s.total_units) AS stddev_total_units,
        COUNT(*) AS subject_count
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
      ON s.department_code = d.department_code
    WHERE d.is_degree_granting = 'Y'
      AND d.department_name <> 'Chemistry'
      AND s.total_units > 0
    GROUP BY d.department_code, d.department_name
),
top_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        d.department_code,
        d.department_name,
        COUNT(*) AS subject_count
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
      ON c.department_code = d.department_code
    WHERE d.is_degree_granting = 'Y'
      AND NOT (
          d.department_name = 'Political Science'
          OR c.subject_number = '17'
      )
      AND c.academic_year = '2022'
    GROUP BY d.department_code, d.department_name
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.subject_count DESC) AS rn
        FROM top_subjects t
    )
    WHERE rn <= 10
)
SELECT
    department_name,
    avg_total_units,
    variance_total_units,
    stddev_total_units,
    subject_count,
    'UnitsStats' AS reason_for_inclusion
FROM units_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT
    department_name,
    NULL AS avg_total_units,
    NULL AS variance_total_units,
    NULL AS stddev_total_units,
    subject_count,
    'TopSubjects2022' AS reason_for_inclusion
FROM top10;

        d.department_code,

        COUNT(*) AS subject_count
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
      ON c.department_code = d.department_code
    WHERE d.is_degree_granting = 'Y'
      AND NOT (
          d.department_name = 'Political Science'

    GROUP BY d.department_code, d.department_name

top10 AS (

        SELECT

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.subject_count DESC) AS rn

SELECT
    u.department_name,
    u.avg_total_units,
    u.variance_total_units,
    u.stddev_total_units,

WHERE NOT EXISTS (

)

FROM top10 t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (

    FROM units_stats u
    WHERE u.department_code = t.department_code
);
